notes.title: Patch Notes and Soundtrack (v2.03)
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes for v2.03[/b]

Hint flames should now all be behaving correctly. 

The Continue Game button on the title menu should now select the most recent overall save and not just the most recent auto-save.

Bug for dragon leg hotspots at cave door entrance remaining active is fixed.

Quit game from the pause menu in-game will now take you to the title screen & not completely quit the program at that point.

Firestarter, parrot & glow picture achievements will attempt to resend at the title menu if there was a connection error when sending the first time.

Improved load times in some areas.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

Additionally, if you'd like to check out the soundtrack for the game, you can pick it up on Bandcamp, listen on Spotify, or find it on iTunes!

Bandcamp - https://nathancleary.bandcamp.com/album/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-ost
iTunes - https://music.apple.com/jp/album/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-original-game-soundtrack/1467115926?l=en
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/5kcXIVpSDq550YxcIoSwLV?si=1A8r2dJqRk2xiUGLs7EgQA



Have a very lovely day and a very happy 4th of July tomorrow for those who celebrate it.

-Sarah/Tooki

notes.title: New Patch Incoming
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/7718ffdaaaccd6a64ef85c7e33baf8a50a4ce2f3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/3811f64ac29f768f38492ad88f8d5819c0b0fbf1.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyone! I hope you all have fab plans ahead for the weekend. 
Just to let everyone know there is a patch landing early next week & it's just getting it's final touches currently. It's mainly addressing some strange behaviour from some of the hint flames & some other little oddities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/d29034eb2ec628ec5491a8fd11af563cbbe3f5a7.png[/img]

Also for future patches I'll be folding in some more player pets so if you would like your fuzzy, scaly or ...slimy? friend to possibly appear in the background I've got this form you can send a picture & details through, where I've been dipping in and grabbing from.

Form here: [url=https://forms.gle/1R3wwf7nhPYe3CPu7]Plank Pets[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

To anyone who has been enjoying the games soundtrack created by Nathan Cleary,  It's available for purchase here:  [url=https://nathancleary.bandcamp.com/album/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-ost]Plank Soundtrack[/url] 

Have a great weekend everyone!

-Sarah/Tooki
